conventions: TypeScript strict, ESM, React 19 function components; prettier via @excalidraw/prettier-config (80 cols, double quotes, trailing commas); eslint --max-warnings=0 must pass.

Import order (eslint import/order): external libs, blank line, @excalidraw/common, blank line, @excalidraw/element (one import statement per line group is fine), blank line, relative imports, then `import type` statements last; use separate `import type` statements (consistent-type-imports).

Packages import each other only through aliases (@excalidraw/common, @excalidraw/element, @excalidraw/element/types, @excalidraw/excalidraw/...); packages/element may import from @excalidraw/excalidraw/types with `import type` only.
Never import jotai directly; never import excalidraw-app code from packages/*.

DOM access goes through app.ownerDocument / app.ownerWindow, never the globals, in packages/excalidraw (AGENTS.md); prefer Merge<Base, Overrides> from @excalidraw/common/utility-types over Omit<> & {}.
Elements are mutated only through newElementWith / mutateElement / scene.mutateElement (which bump version); the single exception is assignElementToPage on an element that is not yet in the scene.

All new UI strings live in packages/excalidraw/locales/en.json under the `pages` namespace and are read with t("pages.x") from ../i18n (or ../../i18n); translation keys are type-checked, so a key used must exist in en.json.

Components: PascalCase .tsx with a sibling .scss imported as `import "./X.scss";`, clsx for class names, BEM-like class names, theme CSS variables (var(--color-primary), var(--button-hover-bg), var(--color-on-surface), var(--island-bg-color), var(--default-border-color), var(--text-primary-color)) and `.excalidraw.theme--dark` for dark overrides; set Component.displayName.

Actions are created with register({...}) from ./register, named in the ActionName union of actions/types.ts and re-exported from actions/index.ts; perform returns { appState, elements?, captureUpdate }.

Tests: Vitest globals (describe/it/expect), `vi` imported from "vitest", jsdom; render/act/waitFor/fireEvent/GlobalTestState from tests/test-utils, API/Keyboard/Pointer/UI from tests/helpers; `const { h } = window;` exposes h.app, h.state, h.elements, h.history; assert with expect(...).toBe/toEqual/toMatchObject; no snapshot assertions in new tests.
Snapshot files (__snapshots__/*.snap) are never typed by hand; they are regenerated by the tooling units that run vitest --update.

decisions.choice: An optional `pageId?: string` on every element (_ExcalidrawElementBase); an absent pageId means the page DEFAULT_PAGE_ID ("default"). The Scene keeps its single ordered, fractionally indexed array of all pages' elements; a page's z-order is the relative order of its elements in that array.
rejected: separate per-page element arrays (would split the Scene, fractional indices, Store snapshots/deltas and collab reconciliation into per-page structures, and break every API that hands over one elements array)
a required pageId (every legacy file, test fixture and host-built element would need it, and every element snapshot would churn)
decisions.reason: pageId is just another element property: Store/History deltas, collab reconciliation by id/version, fractional indices and restore() keep working unchanged, old readers keep the unknown field, and legacy elements land on the default page with no migration.

decisions.topic: Default page id and legacy files (FR-24)
decisions.choice: DEFAULT_PAGE_ID = "default" exported from packages/element/src/pages.ts; getDefaultPages() returns one page {id: "default", name: "Page 1", index: "a0", version: 1, versionNonce: 0, isDeleted: false}; elements on the default page carry no pageId key at all (assignElementToPage deletes the key rather than setting it).
decisions.reason: Legacy files and existing tests need no stamping and produce no snapshot churn; every client derives the same default page id deterministically.

decisions.choice: DrawingPage = { id: string; name: string; index: string (fractional key); version: number; versionNonce: number; isDeleted: boolean }. AppState.pages holds every page record including deleted tombstones; the tab order is getVisiblePages(pages): non-deleted pages sorted by index, ties by id.
rejected: a plain ordered array of {id, name} (concurrent add/rename/delete from two collaborators could only be resolved last-writer-wins for the whole list)
decisions.reason: Per-page version records merge like elements (reconcilePages), so concurrent page edits by collaborators survive; fractional keys make reorder a one-record change.

decisions.choice: AppState.pageViewports: Record<pageId, {scrollX, scrollY, zoom: number}> holds the saved viewport of pages; the active page uses the live scrollX/scrollY/zoom. Switching saves the live viewport under the page being left and restores the target's entry (or scrollX 0, scrollY 0, zoom 1). serializeAsJSON folds the live viewport into pageViewports[activePageId] before writing a local file.
decisions.reason: Keeps the existing scroll/zoom state and every renderer untouched while making the per-page viewport part of the file; pageViewports is not sent to collaborators (server: false).

decisions.choice: pages {browser: true, export: true, server: true}; activePageId {browser: true, export: true, server: true}; pageViewports {browser: true, export: true, server: false}.
decisions.reason: Pages and the active page are saved to the browser and to files and share links; the viewport map stays local and in files.

decisions.choice: Scene gains activePageId; getNonDeletedElements(), getNonDeletedElementsMap() and getNonDeletedFramesLikes() return the active page only, computed in replaceAllElements and setActivePageId (cached, invalidated with the scene nonce); getElementsIncludingDeleted()/getElementsMapIncludingDeleted()/getElement() keep returning every page; new getNonDeletedElementsAllPages() returns every page's non-deleted elements.
decisions.reason: The ~70 existing consumers of getNonDeletedElements (renderer, hit-testing, selection, snapping, binding, frames, fonts) become page-scoped with no edits and no extra pass per pointer move.

decisions.topic: Keeping the scene in step with AppState.activePageId
decisions.choice: App.render() calls scene.setActivePageId(state.activePageId) when they differ; setActivePageId recomputes the caches and the nonce without firing onUpdate callbacks (safe during render). App.componentDidUpdate tells History the active page, reloads scene fonts on change, and switches to the first visible page when the active page is no longer visible (deleted remotely or via updateScene).
decisions.reason: One place covers page switches from actions, updateScene from hosts, tab-sync and collaboration.

decisions.topic: Where new elements get the active page (FR-4, FR-27)
decisions.choice: Scene.insertElementsAtIndex stamps the scene's active page on elements not yet in the scene (all app.insertNewElement(s) paths, text, bucket fill, flowchart); App.addElementsFromPasteOrLibrary stamps the duplicated elements (paste, library, onInsertElements, mermaid/charts); the two actions that build elements themselves pass a pageId to the constructor (actionBoundText: the text's page; wrapSelectionInFrame: appState.activePageId). _newElementBase keeps an incoming pageId (omitting the key for DEFAULT_PAGE_ID), so element-type conversion keeps the page; duplicates copy the original's pageId. syncActionResult never re-stamps, so a loaded multi-page file keeps its pages.
decisions.reason: Clipboard and library data may carry any pageId; stamping at insertion is the only place that knows the active page, and NEVER-captured results (scene init, undo/redo, remote) must keep their pages.

decisions.choice: History keeps one undo and one redo stack per page id (Map); undoStack/redoStack getters return the active page's arrays; App calls history.setActivePage(id) when the active page changes, which emits HistoryChangedEvent. activePageId and pages are not part of the observed app state, so switching is never an undo step and undo never switches page.
decisions.reason: Every element change happens on the active page, so tagging by the page active at record time scopes undo exactly to that page without touching Store or delta code.

decisions.choice: addPage, renamePage, movePage(Left/Right), deletePage and switchPage return captureUpdate CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER: they persist (onChange, local storage, files) and sync, but are not undoable in v1; deletePage marks its elements isDeleted with newElementWith so collaborators and saves see it.
rejected: recording page operations in the undo stacks (a page add/delete spans two pages' stacks and would need appState deltas for pages)
decisions.reason: Matches the approved assumption 2 and keeps History element-only.

decisions.choice: addPage inserts the new page right after the active page (fractional key between the active page and its next visible neighbour), names it with getDefaultPageName ("Page N", N = visible page count + 1, incremented until unused) and switches to it.
decisions.reason: Mirrors spreadsheet/Figma tab behaviour and keeps the new tab next to the context the person was in.

decisions.choice: VERSIONS.excalidraw stays 2; the change is additive (appState.pages, appState.activePageId, appState.pageViewports, element.pageId), and today's restore ignores the unknown appState keys and keeps element.pageId by spread.
decisions.reason: Older readers load new files (showing all pages overlapped on one canvas) instead of rejecting them; no reader branches on the version today.

decisions.choice: restoreAppState always derives pages/activePageId/pageViewports from the imported appState via restorePageState and never falls back to the local appState for these three keys; after restore, reassignOrphanedElementsToPage moves elements whose pageId is not a visible page onto the first visible page (file load in blob.ts and App.initializeScene only, never in the collab path).
decisions.reason: Loading a legacy file while the browser holds a multi-page drawing must yield exactly one default page (AC-5), and remote elements may legitimately arrive before their page.

decisions.topic: Image export and embedded scene (FR-26 ADR)
decisions.choice: prepareElementsForExport filters to appState.activePageId when given, so PNG/SVG/clipboard/resave export only the active page; the embedded scene (PNG/SVG metadata) is written with toActivePageExportState(appState): pages reduced to the active page and pageViewports to its entry.
decisions.reason: Approved assumption 4: the embedded scene matches the visible export; re-importing an exported image yields a one-page drawing.

decisions.choice: ExcalidrawImperativeAPI.getSceneElements() returns every page's non-deleted elements (scene.getNonDeletedElementsAllPages()); getSceneElementsIncludingDeleted() is unchanged (all pages); the JSON export dialog receives all pages' elements, the image export dialog only the active page's.
decisions.reason: Hosts (excalidraw-app collab start, share links, Excalidraw+ export, unload checks) treat it as the whole drawing; returning one page would drop the others when they write it back.

decisions.choice: SCENE_INIT and SCENE_UPDATE payloads gain an optional `pages: DrawingPage[]` (all records incl. tombstones); a client broadcasts pages whenever getPagesVersion(pages) exceeds its last broadcast/received pages version, and always in INIT and the periodic full sync; receivers merge with reconcilePages and apply via updateScene({appState: {pages}}, NEVER). activePageId and pageViewports are never sent.
rejected: a new WS subtype for pages (two messages per change, and old clients would log an unknown subtype)
decisions.reason: Old clients ignore the extra payload key; pages ride the same encrypted channel as elements.

decisions.choice: The scenes/{roomId} document keeps sceneVersion/iv/ciphertext (elements array, unchanged) and gains optional pagesIv/pagesCiphertext: the JSON page records encrypted with the room key; saveToFirebase reconciles stored pages with local ones inside the transaction; a document without pages fields loads as null pages, which restore turns into the default page. The cached saved-version is getSceneVersion(elements) + getPagesVersion(pages).
decisions.reason: Additive fields: rooms saved before the change load unchanged, and an old client's transaction.update leaves the pages fields in place.

decisions.topic: Tab bar placement and visibility (FR-19 ADR)
decisions.choice: PagesTabBar renders in the desktop Footer between footer-left and the FooterCenter tunnel, and in the mobile bottom bar above the toolbar island; it renders nothing when zenModeEnabled is true or the host passes UIOptions.pages === false; in view mode it shows the tabs (switching works) but hides the add button, rename, drag and the tab menu.
decisions.reason: Approved assumption 3; viewers may switch pages per the role matrix.

decisions.choice: handleSearch scans scene.getNonDeletedElementsAllPages(); each SearchMatchItem carries pageId; result rows show the page name when the drawing has more than one visible page; focusing a match on another page first runs actionSwitchPage (source "ui") and the zoom-to-match effect re-runs once activePageId changes.
decisions.reason: Search spans the drawing while highlighting and viewport logic stay page-local.

decisions.choice: Library items and clipboard payloads are left as they are (they may contain a pageId); insertion through addElementsFromPasteOrLibrary always reassigns the active page.
decisions.reason: One stamping point is simpler and covers older clipboard/library data too.

decisions.choice: Snapshots that hold AppState (contextmenu, history, regressionTests) and the embedded-scene SVG payloads (export.test.tsx, scene/export.test.ts) are regenerated by tooling units running vitest --update on exactly those test files after all code lands; element snapshots do not change because default-page elements carry no pageId.
decisions.reason: Approved assumption 5; reviewers check the regenerated diff only adds the page fields.

units.behaviour: Pure page helpers: default page, visible ordering, create/rename/reorder/delete records, page membership of elements, page reconciliation and versioning.
rules: DEFAULT_PAGE_ID = "default"; getDefaultPages() returns [{ id: DEFAULT_PAGE_ID, name: "Page 1", index: "a0", version: 1, versionNonce: 0, isDeleted: false }].
getElementPageId(element) returns element.pageId ?? DEFAULT_PAGE_ID; isElementOnPage(element, pageId) compares that.
getVisiblePages(pages): non-deleted pages sorted by index (string compare), ties by id; never mutates the input.
getDefaultPageName(pages): "Page N" where N starts at visible count + 1 and increments while a visible page already has that exact name.

createPage(pages, afterPageId, name?): new record with id randomId(), name ?? getDefaultPageName(pages), version 1, versionNonce randomInteger(), isDeleted false, index generateKeyBetween(after.index, nextVisible?.index ?? null) from @excalidraw/fractional-indexing (after = the visible page afterPageId, or the last visible page when not found; null bounds when no visible pages); returns { pages: [...pages, page], page }.
Every record update goes through a local bumpPage(page, updates) that returns a new object with version + 1 and a new randomInteger() versionNonce.
renamePage(pages, pageId, name): trimmed name; returns the same array when the trimmed name is empty, the page is missing/deleted, or the name is unchanged; else the array with that record bumped.

movePage(pages, pageId, toIndex): toIndex is a position in getVisiblePages without the moved page, clamped to [0, length]; computes generateKeyBetween(prev?.index ?? null, next?.index ?? null) for the gap and bumps that one record; returns the same array when the position does not change.
deletePage(pages, pageId): returns the same array when the page is missing/deleted or it is the only visible page; else that record bumped with isDeleted true.
getAdjacentPageId(pages, pageId): id of the next visible page after pageId, else the previous one, else null.
getPageElements(elements, pageId): elements on that page, deleted included, in array order.
assignElementToPage(element, pageId): mutates the plain object in place (for elements not yet in a scene): deletes the pageId key for DEFAULT_PAGE_ID, else sets it; returns the element.

reassignOrphanedElementsToPage(elements, pages): elements whose page is not a visible page get newElementWith(element, { pageId: firstVisible.id === DEFAULT_PAGE_ID ? undefined : firstVisible.id }) plus deleting a leftover pageId key for the default page via a spread copy; returns the same array when nothing changes.

reconcilePages(local, remote): union by id; for an id in both keep the record with the higher version, ties to the lower versionNonce; result is ordered by index then id; returns local unchanged when remote is null/undefined or empty.
getPagesVersion(pages): sum of versions (0 for undefined).

restorePageState(appState): validates untrusted input. pages: keep entries that are objects with a non-empty string id and string name, unique by id (first wins), fill index (generateNKeysBetween for missing/invalid keys in array order, using validateOrderKey in try/catch), version (finite >= 1 else 1), versionNonce (finite else 0), isDeleted (boolean else false); when no visible page remains return getDefaultPages(). activePageId: the given id when it is a visible page, else the first visible page id. pageViewports: keep entries whose key is a known page id and whose scrollX/scrollY/zoom are finite numbers (zoom > 0); else {}.

toActivePageExportState(appState): returns { ...appState, pages: only the active page record (or getDefaultPages() when missing), pageViewports: only the active page entry when present }; leaves other keys as they are.

units.behaviour: The page actions: add, switch, rename, move left/right, move to index, delete.
rules: Each action is register({...}) with trackEvent { category: "canvas" } and returns captureUpdate CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER (page structure is not undoable; switching never is).

A shared getPageSwitchAppState(appState, targetPageId) returns the partial AppState for a switch: pageViewports with the live {scrollX, scrollY, zoom: zoom.value} stored under appState.activePageId; activePageId target; scrollX/scrollY/zoom from pageViewports[target] (zoom via getNormalizedZoom) or 0/0/1; cleared selectedElementIds {}, selectedGroupIds {}, editingGroupId null, previousSelectedElementIds {}, hoveredElementIds {}, selectedLinearElement null, editingTextElement null, newElement null, multiElement null, resizingElement null, isCropping false, croppingElementId null, suggestedBinding null, frameToHighlight null, elementsToHighlight null, activeEmbeddable null, editingFrame null, snapLines [], searchMatches unchanged, contextMenu null. Returns null when target equals the active page or is not a visible page.
actionSwitchPage (name switchPage, viewMode true, label pages.switchPage): value is the target page id; returns false when getPageSwitchAppState is null.

actionAddPage (name addPage, viewMode false, label pages.addPage, icon PlusIcon): createPage(appState.pages, appState.activePageId); then switch to it via getPageSwitchAppState over the appState with the new pages.
actionRenamePage (name renamePage, viewMode false, label pages.renamePage): value { pageId: string; name: string }; renamePage(...); returns false when the array is unchanged (empty or same name).
actionMovePage (name movePage, viewMode false, label pages.movePage): value { pageId: string; toIndex: number }; movePage(...); false when unchanged.

actionMovePageLeft / actionMovePageRight (names movePageLeft/movePageRight, labels pages.movePageLeft/movePageRight): value is a page id or null (null = active page); move to its visible position - 1 / + 1; predicate false when already first / last; false when unchanged.

actionDeletePage (name deletePage, viewMode false, label pages.deletePage, icon TrashIcon): value page id or null (active); predicate false when only one visible page; computes adjacent = getAdjacentPageId before deleting; elements returned = elements.map(el => isElementOnPage(el, pageId) && !el.isDeleted ? newElementWith(el, { isDeleted: true }) : el); pages = deletePage(...); when the deleted page is active, also applies getPageSwitchAppState toward adjacent (computed on the pre-delete pages) and drops pageViewports[pageId]; returns false when deletePage leaves pages unchanged.
Every action's perform returns false when the editor is in view mode and the action is not viewMode (rely on the manager) and never touches other pages' elements.
